metadata.content:
*Revitalizing plants and jagged stones grow, helping allies and hindering foes.*

| **Area, Earth, Green, Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)** |   **Maneuver** |
|---------------------------------------|---------------:|
| **📏 3 [cube](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/cube) within 10**               | **🎯 Special** |

**Effect:** Until the start of your next [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn), the area gains the following effects:

- Once as a [free maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/free-maneuver) at the start of your [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn), you allow yourself and each ally in the area to spend any number of [Recoveries](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/recoveries).
- The area is [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain) for enemies.
- Each enemy who enters the area for the first time in a [combat round](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/combat-round) or starts their turn there takes damage equal to your [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) score.

**Persistent 1:** The area remains until the start of your next [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn). As a maneuver, you can move the area up to 5 squares. This ability ends if the area is ever not within your [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect).
